author: nflaig
content: lodestar will queue the payload envelope and wait for the beacon block to be imported, you can and probably should also call `publishBlockV2` when you receive the beacon block from the proposer over the builder api

author: nflaig
content: we have `consensus_and_equivocation` implemented on the payload envelope publish api which will reject publishing if there is an observed equivocation but if the block has >60% weight it would still be safe to publish I assume? in any case, a builder will not have to pay if proposer is slashed which it will, so the simple solution here seems to be to just withhold if there is an equivocation

author: potuz
content:
The timings of the equivocations matter and it's the other way around . Some remarks: 

1) not weak is 20% not 60% with 20% the block will get already propose boost. 
2) if the builder waited until the deadline and there weren't equivocations until then, then it doesn't matter even the 20%, the parent will get PB no matter what. 


So counting attestations should always be to 20%  and not 60 as some have been claiming and that 20 is only in the niche case that the next proposer is modded to reorg the block l, which vanilla clients will not do if it was early

author: potuz
content: I'm assuming synchrony of course: it could always happen that the builder magically didn't see the equivocating block that was early and somehow managed 40% of the vote without the builder seeing it on time. I just think if I were a builder I would not count for this case. If the chain is in that situation I'm pretty sure builders would not even be bidding already, at least not trustless bids
